evidence: Substantially modifies wallet transaction building, coin selection, RBF fee bumping, and database persistence (src/wallet/spend.cpp, feebumper.cpp, walletdb.cpp) to support sending to silent payment addresses.
rationale: Adds wallet sending support for BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses, solving a key receiver privacy limitation for Bitcoin Core users. It alters critical wallet pathways including coin selection constraints and dynamic output script generation during RBF bumps.
